description: The Declarant gives importers and customs teams read-only access to practical EU customs intelligence in ChatGPT. Search HS, CN and TARIC codes, estimate customs duty, import VAT, CBAM costs and total landed cost, check preferential origin rules, and review tariff-change alerts for your account. It does not file declarations, contact authorities, make payments, or change account data.

defaultPrompt: Find the best EU commodity code for this product and explain the likely matches.
Estimate the landed cost of importing this shipment into the EU.
Check whether this shipment may qualify for preferential origin treatment.
